question:
Consider the exponential function $f(x)=3^x$.
(i) Find $f(0)$, $f(2)$ and $f(-2)$.
(ii) Show that $f(x)>0$ for every real $x$ and hence determine whether the equation $3^x=0$ has a real solution.
explanation:
Evaluation of the function
$$f(0)=3^0=1$$
$$f(2)=3^2=9$$
$$f(-2)=3^{-2}=\frac{1}{9}$$
Positivity of the exponential function
For every real $x$, the value $3^x$ is positive. Therefore, $$3^x>0$$ for all $x\in\mathbb{R}$.
Conclusion
Since $3^x$ can never be zero, the equation $$3^x=0$$ has no real solution.

options.B: (i) $f(0)=1$, $f(2)=9$, $f(-2)=\frac{1}{9}$; (ii) $3^x>0$ for all real $x$, so $3^x=0$ has no real solution.
